semiconductor_relevance: Low — Festo Korea primarily provides automation solutions and products that are not specifically tailored for the semiconductor industry.
summary: Festo Korea Co., Ltd. specializes in automation systems and solutions, offering a wide range of products including pneumatic and electrical drive technologies. While they serve various industries, their offerings do not directly address semiconductor manufacturing processes.

regional_presence.Korea: Festo Korea has been established in Seoul since 1980, providing automation solutions tailored to the local market.
